calibrated_validation.description: The user made time pressure the load-bearing stake three times ('i need to move fast,' 'i need the draft notice by 2:30,' 'needs to go in before 4:00 or we lose the filing window'), yet no assistant reply ever acknowledges or calibrates to the clock, and the reply to the time-critical complaint ask defers without engaging the window at all. Each substantive item (notice, serve-or-dump, kitchen log) was otherwise taken up in the asked mode, no feeling bid was disclosed, and there is no V2/V3 — so this is a mild, localized context-recognition skip rather than a person-absent dump.
calibrated_validation.quote: Then I'll tell you what I can draft and what I won't.
